name: A Gift From Our Enemies
summary: Gorg asks you to bring stolen feed to Rog'mar so its allies can be fed. Nearby gnolls and the encroaching Twilight threaten the settlement.

sections.title: Food for Rog'mar
sections.body: Gorg is waiting in Rog'mar for the stolen feed you gathered. The humans are not the only threat nearby: gnolls snarl from the hills, and the Twilight encroaches. Keeping Rog'mar's allies fed may help preserve their strength.

sections.title: A Hearty Stew
sections.body: The feed smells pungent and earthy, with something unpleasant beneath it. Gorg recognizes that you took it from the farmstead and says it will make a hearty stew for the allies.

faq.q: Why does Gorg want the stolen feed?
faq.answer: Gorg will use the stolen feed to make a hearty stew for Rog'mar's allies.
The humans are one threat, while gnolls snarl from nearby hills and the Twilight encroaches.
Gorg is the one who receives the stolen feed in Rog'mar and says it can make a hearty stew.

faq.q: Where do I take the stolen feed?
faq.answer: Take the stolen feed to Gorg in Rog'mar.

attribution: In-game quest text: A Gift From Our Enemies
